name: Artemis Midasakis
source:
As the rightful heir to House Midasakis, Artemis is favoured by the elder family members. She has immense influence in her family. She is the perfect privileged heir, well, at least from her appearance.

Before the rise of Melantha, Artemis had no particular opinion about her. Melantha had to endure some regular scoff and sarcasm from Artemis because after all, bullying Melantha has become a pastime for Artemis.
